# Spaces counterparty corpus

These fixtures are **generated by the official reference implementation** of
atproto proposal 0016 (permissioned data), not by exosphere. They are the G1
conformance gate's strongest evidence: exosphere's primitives must reproduce or
verify these exact bytes.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto>, branch `permissioned-data`
- Pinned commit: `787a730fcd22ed7791e2636beb509a943017ba1c` (2026-09-22)
- Package: `@atproto/space@0.0.1` (MIT), with `@atproto/crypto` and `@atproto/car`
  from the same checkout
- Generator: `generate.mjs` in this directory (committed alongside the fixtures)
- Generated: 2026-09-25

## To regenerate

From a checkout of the atproto repo at the pinned commit with dependencies
installed and `packages/space` built (`pnpm install && pnpm --filter
@atproto/space... run build`):

```sh
cd /path/to/atproto            # or pass --atproto /path/to/atproto
node test/fixtures/spaces-corpora/generate.mjs \
  --out test/fixtures/spaces-corpora
git diff test/fixtures/spaces-corpora   # must be empty for the byte-deterministic files
```

`lthash.json`, `signed-commit.json`, and `repo-car.json` are byte-deterministic
(fixed keys, fixed ikm, fixed records; RFC 6979 signing on both sides) — a
regeneration diff on those files means the reference moved. `credentials.json`
is deliberately NOT byte-reproducible (`iat`/`jti` are fresh per run); its
assertions are on the decoded token classes and signature validity, never on
the JWT bytes.

## Coverage

| Fixture | What it pins | Exercised by |
|---|---|---|
| `lthash.json` | Lane math (LE u16, mod 2^16), BLAKE3-XOF expansion, empty/multi/add-remove/multiset/underflow states, 512-byte rkey element | `interop/spaces_corpus_test.exs` vs `Spaces.LtHash` |
| `signed-commit.json` | TLS-1.3-style ctx encoding (incl. a 532-byte space URI), HKDF-Expand-only MAC, deterministic secp256k1 sig, `signedCommit` field bytes | `interop/spaces_corpus_test.exs` vs `Spaces.Commit` |
| `repo-car.json` | Two-root CAR layout, canonical (shortest-first) DRISL index order — the record set contains a pair whose length-first and bytewise orders differ — block order, per-block CBOR bytes, index-only variant | `interop/spaces_corpus_test.exs` vs `Spaces.Repo` |
| `credentials.json` | The three token classes' `typ`/`kid` headers, claim shapes, TTLs (`exp - iat`), `cnf.jkt` binding | `interop/spaces_corpus_test.exs` vs `Spaces.Token` |

The corpus is checked in (not fetched) so the suite runs offline and
deterministically in CI, mirroring the `fixtures/interop` convention.
